task: Architecture P1: shared Core library (Signal, Tags, ConnectionScope, ConfigReader)
contract: Goal: shared Core utilities for later phases. New pure libraries Signal and Tags under ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Core; ConnectionScope gains add/task and failure-isolated reverse cleanup (connect/destroy unchanged); ConfigReader keeps every existing return value for valid config, falls back on non-finite/wrong-class values and reports present-but-invalid or clamped values once per key, and adds NumberAttribute/BoolAttribute/IsFinite. No ServerBase/ClientBase entries, remotes, saved data or UI. Owners unchanged. Done when: pure tests pass, AUDIT/APPLY/ROLLBACK/APPLY cycle is clean, normal startup reaches all features ready with no new errors, and any ConfigReader warnings are recorded as real config gaps.
verification: tooling (p1/tests.lua), installation (captures), startup (normal Play start screen), errors (console)
